subject: VPC pricing: platform fee bifurcation, implementation credit & on-call carveout
body:
--- Message 1 (original) ---
From: Liam O’Connor <liam@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliotherapeutics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: VPC commercial split and ops carveouts

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs are aligned on moving forward with a Private (VPC) deployment but they have three outstanding asks that will determine final approvers on our side:

1) Fee bifurcation: they want clearer separation between the platform (software) fee and the ops/oncall retainer. We have to budget these to two different POs. Can you provide a breakdown that makes the amortization explicit over a 36-month term?

2) Implementation credit: given integration scope (HIPAA connectors + SSO + 3-week pilot), can you provide an implementation credit or offset against month-1 invoices? They are pushing for a one-time credit to come off the platform fee.

3) On-call carveout: Helio's legal wants on-call obligations limited to severity 1 and 2 incidents for production-hour coverage; anything outside that should be billable at T&M or handled as an SOW.

We attached the high-level MA plan (Helio_Therapeutics_MA-plan_v2.xlsx). Please respond with the simplest packaging that will fly through procurement.

Appreciate it,
Liam
Procurement
Helio Therapeutics

--- Message 2 (internal reply) ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O’Connor <liam@heliotherapeutics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: VPC commercial split and ops carveouts

Liam,

Thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and we'll follow with a compact breakdown PDF you can hand to procurement by EOD tomorrow.

1) Fee bifurcation: we can split into (a) Platform license (annualized, amortized over 36 months) and (b) Ops retainer (monthly on-call + runbook retainers). Platform fee can be presented on the PO as a capitalizable software license line; ops retainer as an OPEX line. We'll include a simple table that shows annualized platform fee, monthly ops retainer, and effective blended per-token rate for expected usage.

2) Implementation credit: we can offer a one-time credit equal to 15% of the initial platform fee applied to the first invoice, conditional on a 24-month minimum commitment. Alternatively, if they want no term requirement, we can do a smaller credit (7.5%) with a refundable escrow holdback clause for the integration milestones. We'll include both options so procurement can choose.

3) On-call carveout: we routinely contract SRE on-call for Sev1/Sev2 during production hours. Anything outside that scope (non-prod, low severity, or feature requests) is scoped as either billable T&M or an SOW. We can add an explicit carveout clause to the SOW and define response and remediation SLAs.

Marissa, David: can you review the numbers in the attachment I asked Legal to generate (RDW_platform_fee_breakdown.pdf) and confirm we can commit to the 15% credit with 24-month min? If not, propose the alternate escrow wording.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (internal coordination) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: VPC commercial split and ops carveouts

Naomi,

Quick internal note before we reply to Helio:

- 15% credit with 24-month commitment: fine from a commercial perspective; it preserves ARR and is easy to model. Use it as the preferred option.
- Escrow alternative (7.5% no-term): Legal flags the mechanics but okay as fallback; requires a 90-day escrow release tied to integration acceptance.
- On-call carveout: engineering (David) confirms we can limit Redwood on-call to Prod Sev1/Sev2 with clearly defined maintenance windows. Anything outside must be SOW/T&M.
- Pricing presentation: I'll create a two-row pricing table (Platform fee amortized / Ops retainer monthly) + a third line for implementation credit.

Action: Naomi, I'll attach the clean pricing table and a one-pager that procurement can drop into the PO.

-Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 (external confirming response) ---
From: Liam O’Connor <liam@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliotherapeutics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: VPC commercial split and ops carveouts

Thanks Naomi / Marissa 1

This looks good. Procurement prefers the 15% credit with 24-month minimum; they'll attach the amortized platform line to a capital PO and the ops retainer to an OPEX PO. Two quick asks before I close the loop:

1) Can you add a one-sentence escrow fallback to the contract ("In the event of integration failure, Helio may request a pro-rata release of credited funds subject to joint acceptance tests").
2) Please include an appendix that defines Severity 1 and 2 (examples + expected response times).

If you can get the updated PDF and short appendix to procurement by EOD Friday we can route to approvers next week.

Please send the invoice schedule with the amortized numbers and I'll share with finance.

Best,
Liam
Helio Therapeutics

--- Attachments referenced in thread ---
- Helio_Therapeutics_MA-plan_v2.xlsx (high-level milestone and SOW outline)
- RDW_platform_fee_breakdown.pdf (platform fee amortization table, proposed credits)

--- End of thread ---
